assignments.value:
=Hi {{ $json.first_name }}, I am your interview practice coach.

/setup - send me your CV and tell me about the job, so I grade you against the role you are actually going for

/practice - a question, weighted toward your weak topics
/practice behavioural - a question on one topic
/practice weak - drill your three weakest topics
/hint - a nudge on the question you have open (costs 0.5)
/skip - a different question
/weak - your three weakest topics over the last 14 days
/stats - answers graded, average score and streak

Topics: behavioural, motivation, technical, company-fit, competency, case

Answer by typing or by sending a voice note.

value.hints_used: ={{ ($('Find the open question').first().json.fields || $('Find the open question').first().json).hints_used || 0 }}

parameters.text: You have no question open at the moment. Send /practice to get one, then answer it.

Let's set up your context.

Step 1 of 2: send me your CV as a PDF file (attach it, don't paste the text).

I'll use it, along with what you tell me about the role, to judge your answers against the job you're actually going for.

Got your CV.

Step 2 of 2: send me a voice note about the job. Who's the company, what's the role, and anything you know about what they care about.

Talk for thirty seconds or so. The next voice note you send will be treated as this brief, and after that voice notes go back to being interview answers.
